_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'History Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 12, Part III: History of Central Africa, Topics 12.1-12.6. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column is omitted for the reasons documented in the Grade 10 file. This document's printed outcome numbering drifts throughout (as in Grades 10 and 11), so outcomes were reconstructed positionally against each sub-topic heading in the table's own reading order. Under 12.5 (European Settlers in Central Africa), sub-topic headers 12.5.4-12.5.6 are printed as a block on the page after eight outcomes that are all printed with 12.5.3.x/12.5.4.x codes but belong entirely to the single 12.5.3 heading that precedes them on the prior page (the same 'sub-topic headers as a block, then outcomes' layout seen throughout these OBC syllabi); two outcomes in that block are printed twice with identical wording and were deduplicated. Cross-checked against the syllabus's own Scope and Sequence Chart, which confirms the topic list and theme names used here. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 12 is modeled as a single term here.

sub_topics.name: 12.1.1 Physical and Climatic Features and Their Influence on Population Distribution

topics.description: Part III: History of Central Africa.

competencies.description: Describe the causes and courses of Bantu migrations
Locate on the map the areas of Bantu settlement after migration
Discuss the results of the Bantu migrations
Identify decentralised societies of Zambia
Describe the social, political and economic organisation of decentralised societies
Identify centralised societies of Central Africa
Describe the social, political and economic organisation of centralised societies
